WhatsNew.1235.zh-Hans: 恢复 ⌘← 和 ⌘→ 后退、前进功能。

WhatsNew.1237.en: Addresses a dev server prints, like 0.0.0.0:3000, open.
WhatsNew.1237.zh-Hans: 支持打开开发服务器输出的地址，如 0.0.0.0:3000。

WhatsNew.1238.en: The tabs you had at quit are the ones that come back.
WhatsNew.1238.zh-Hans: 重启后恢复退出时的标签页。

WhatsNew.1239.en: The × closes a tab in the tab bar folded away with ⌘S.
WhatsNew.1239.zh-Hans: 修复用 ⌘S 收起标签栏后，× 按钮关闭标签页的问题。

WhatsNew.1240.en: 1Password, Bitwarden, NordPass, Passbolt, iCloud Passwords and the Claude extension each get their fixes.
WhatsNew.1240.zh-Hans: 修复 1Password、Bitwarden、NordPass、Passbolt、iCloud 密码和 Claude 扩展的相关问题。

WhatsNew.1243.zh-Hans: 安全性和鼠标滚轮改进。

WhatsNew.1244.en: Copying a saved password asks for Touch ID.
WhatsNew.1244.zh-Hans: 复制已保存密码时要求触控 ID 验证。

WhatsNew.1245.en: A mouse wheel scrolls smoothly again on x.com and pages like it.
WhatsNew.1245.zh-Hans: 恢复 x.com 等页面上的流畅滚轮滚动。

WhatsNew.1246.zh-Hans: 加快历史记录面板的打开速度。

WhatsNew.1247.en: Music keeps playing when you switch spaces.
WhatsNew.1247.zh-Hans: 切换空间时音乐继续播放。

WhatsNew.1248.zh-Hans: 弹出窗口需要用户点击才能打开。

WhatsNew.1249.en: The holes found in this week's reviews: an extension could read files outside its own folder, and a page or an ad could open another app without asking.
WhatsNew.1249.zh-Hans: 修复本周审查发现的漏洞：扩展可读取自身目录以外的文件，网页或广告可未经确认打开其他应用。

WhatsNew.1250.en: Bitwarden signs in to a self-hosted server, and extension popups hear what changes while they're open.
WhatsNew.1250.zh-Hans: 支持 Bitwarden 登录自托管服务器，扩展弹出窗口可在打开期间接收状态变化。

WhatsNew.1251.en: A link from Mail brings SearcheXtra to the front, and a full-screen video no longer goes black.
WhatsNew.1251.zh-Hans: 邮件中的链接会让 SearcheXtra 切换到前台，修复全屏视频黑屏问题。

WhatsNew.1252.en: Your extensions may each ask once more for their permissions at their next update.
WhatsNew.1252.zh-Hans: 扩展下次更新时，可能会再次请求权限确认。

WhatsNew.1254.zh-Hans: 通行密钥、密码管理器及 Google 兼容性改进。

WhatsNew.1255.en: A site's passkey button brings up the Mac's own passkey sheet: Touch ID, your iPhone, a security key.
WhatsNew.1255.zh-Hans: 网站的通行密钥按钮可调起 Mac 的系统面板，支持触控 ID、iPhone 和安全密钥。

WhatsNew.1256.en: SearcheXtra can be the Mac's default browser.
WhatsNew.1256.zh-Hans: SearcheXtra 可设为 Mac 的默认浏览器。

WhatsNew.1257.en: Each off until you turn it on in Settings: a bookmarks bar, a peek at a link with a shift-click, the video that follows you to another app, pages at 120 Hz, and where a link goes.
WhatsNew.1257.zh-Hans: 新增书签栏、Shift 单击预览链接、切换应用时自动画中画、120 Hz 页面刷新和链接地址显示，可在设置中开启。

WhatsNew.1258.en: Mute a tab, share a page, copy a link as Markdown, the mouse's back and forward buttons, and spaces in the bar across the top.
WhatsNew.1258.zh-Hans: 支持标签页静音、共享页面、复制 Markdown 链接、鼠标前进后退按钮，以及在顶部标签栏中显示空间。

WhatsNew.1259.en: Faster to open, and new tabs in about 10 ms.
WhatsNew.1259.zh-Hans: 加快启动速度，新建标签页约需 10 毫秒。

WhatsNew.1260.en: Pages see nothing of SearcheXtra that Safari doesn't show them, and a saved password is offered only on its own site.
WhatsNew.1260.zh-Hans: 网页能读取的浏览器信息与 Safari 保持一致，已保存密码仅在对应网站上提供。

WhatsNew.1261.zh-Hans: 改进 1Password、Bitwarden 和 Proton Pass 的兼容性。

WhatsNew.1262.en: If passkeys still fail after the update, restart your Mac once.
WhatsNew.1262.zh-Hans: 更新后若通行密钥仍无法使用，请重启 Mac。

WhatsNew.1264.en: The first update, made of a day of your replies and pull requests.
WhatsNew.1264.zh-Hans: 首次更新，根据一天内收到的反馈和拉取请求改进。

WhatsNew.1265.en: Each off until you turn it on in Settings: Spaces, a sidebar that hides until the pointer reaches the edge, and the search engine of your choice.
WhatsNew.1265.zh-Hans: 新增空间、指针移至边缘才显示的侧边栏和自选搜索引擎，可在设置中启用。

WhatsNew.1266.en: ⌘S folds the sidebar away, a middle-click closes a tab, a tab can be renamed, and the Web Inspector is in the View menu.
WhatsNew.1266.zh-Hans: ⌘S 可收起侧边栏，中键可关闭标签页，支持重命名标签页，并在“显示”菜单中加入网页检查器。

WhatsNew.1267.zh-Hans: 恢复 macOS 14 上的启动支持。

WhatsNew.1268.en: Signing in to Google no longer reloads the page over and over with iCloud Passwords installed.
WhatsNew.1268.zh-Hans: 修复安装 iCloud 密码扩展后，登录 Google 时页面反复重载的问题。

WhatsNew.1269.en: ⌘1–⌘9 on every keyboard layout, Tab between a form's fields, dragging tabs, a double-click along the top to fill the screen, and the Mac's beep while typing.
WhatsNew.1269.zh-Hans: 修复不同键盘布局下的 ⌘1–⌘9、表单 Tab 切换、拖动标签页、双击顶部填满屏幕，以及输入时的系统提示音问题。

WhatsNew.1271.en: The first version. A browser for the Mac with nothing in the way.
WhatsNew.1271.zh-Hans: 首个版本。为 Mac 打造的简洁浏览器。

WhatsNew.1272.en: Tabs in a row or down the side, pinned tabs that keep their place, and one field for addresses and searches.
WhatsNew.1272.zh-Hans: 标签页可横排或竖排，固定标签页保留位置，一个输入框同时用于网址和搜索。

WhatsNew.1273.en: Ads blocked before they load; passwords and passkeys in your keychain.
WhatsNew.1273.zh-Hans: 加载前拦截广告，密码和通行密钥保存在钥匙串中。

WhatsNew.1274.en: Anything on a page can be hidden; articles open in a reading mode and videos float.
WhatsNew.1274.zh-Hans: 可隐藏网页元素，文章支持阅读模式，视频支持画中画。

WhatsNew.1275.en: Chrome extensions from the Chrome Web Store, on macOS 15.4 or later.
WhatsNew.1275.zh-Hans: 在 macOS 15.4 或更新版本上支持 Chrome 应用商店扩展。

WhatsNew.1276.en: Tabs you haven't looked at for half an hour sleep and give their memory back.
WhatsNew.1276.zh-Hans: 半小时未查看的标签页会休眠并释放内存。

WhatsNew.1277.en: It runs on the engine already in macOS and weighs 2.9 MB.
WhatsNew.1277.zh-Hans: 使用 macOS 内置引擎，体积仅 2.9 MB。

upstream.settings.a27f029ce4.zh-Hans: 为各组空间提供独立登录、历史记录和书签

upstream.settings.3906b51121.en: In windows of their own. Extensions, passwords and settings are shared.
upstream.settings.3906b51121.zh-Hans: 各配置在独立窗口中使用，扩展、密码和设置仍然共享。

upstream.settings.3a34d1db9a.en: Links elsewhere open over the pin, and ⌘W takes it back home
upstream.settings.3a34d1db9a.zh-Hans: 跨站链接以预览方式打开，⌘W 返回固定时的页面

upstream.settings.da76021d36.en: As in Arc and Safari: a link from a pin to another site opens in a peek over it, and a pin closed with ⌘W, or left open when SearcheXtra quits, comes back at the page it was pinned at.
upstream.settings.da76021d36.zh-Hans: 固定标签中的跨站链接在预览面板打开。按 ⌘W 关闭或重启浏览器后，固定标签会返回固定时的网址。

upstream.settings.5635856487.en: Pins as rows under the squares, and Clear over the rest
upstream.settings.5635856487.zh-Hans: 在方形固定标签下显示行式标签，并在普通标签上方提供“清除”

upstream.settings.177a9fcabd.en: As in Arc: squares for the sites you live in, rows for pages you keep, and a line over the rest with Clear. Right-click a tab to pin it as a row.
upstream.settings.177a9fcabd.zh-Hans: 方形标签用于常用网站，行式标签用于保留页面，其下方是普通标签和“清除”按钮。可右键将标签固定为行式。

upstream.settings.9f78ee0aea.en: settings or new tab alone in the address field goes there
upstream.settings.9f78ee0aea.zh-Hans: 在地址栏单独输入 settings 或 new tab 可执行对应命令

upstream.settings.6e93be1b67.en: Pins, groups and named tabs come back; last time's others don't
upstream.settings.6e93be1b67.zh-Hans: 启动时恢复固定、分组和命名标签，其余标签不恢复

upstream.settings.f0b3bc8adf.en: Click a sign-in box and your accounts for the site hang from it
upstream.settings.f0b3bc8adf.zh-Hans: 点击登录框时显示该网站已保存的账号

upstream.settings.aa8f556dce.en: Your Passwords app's accounts under the sign-in box. Unofficial
upstream.settings.aa8f556dce.zh-Hans: 在登录框下显示 Apple“密码”账号，使用非官方集成

upstream.settings.a43ca65dfb.en: SearcheXtra talks to the helper Apple made for its Chrome extension, as that extension. Never in private tabs.
upstream.settings.a43ca65dfb.zh-Hans: SearcheXtra 通过 Apple 为 Chrome 扩展提供的辅助程序访问密码，不用于无痕标签。

upstream.settings.0744c57b83.en: As in Safari. Private tabs keep it on
upstream.settings.0744c57b83.zh-Hans: 类似 Safari，无痕标签始终开启

upstream.settings.c3d31a62a1.en: Off, sites you rarely open keep their sign-ins, and trackers inside other sites can follow you across them again, as in Chrome.
upstream.settings.c3d31a62a1.zh-Hans: 关闭后较少访问的网站也会保留登录状态，嵌入其他网站的跟踪器也可能重新跨站跟踪。

upstream.settings.8631549282.zh-Hans: 移除链接中的点击跟踪标识

upstream.settings.d4712327c0.en: gclid, fbclid and the like go before the page loads. Private tabs always
upstream.settings.d4712327c0.zh-Hans: 加载页面前移除 gclid、fbclid 等标识，无痕标签始终启用

upstream.settings.be82654f6b.en: The IDs an ad network adds to a link so the site can tell whose click it was. Campaign tags (utm_) stay, as in Safari.
upstream.settings.be82654f6b.zh-Hans: 广告网络通过这些标识识别链接点击来源。与 Safari 一样，utm_ 等推广参数仍会保留。

upstream.settings.a16ae52957.en: Tell sites not to sell or share your data
upstream.settings.a16ae52957.zh-Hans: 通知网站不要出售或共享你的数据

upstream.settings.8fc60c90ae.en: Global Privacy Control, with every request. Private tabs always
upstream.settings.8fc60c90ae.zh-Hans: 每次请求发送全局隐私控制信号，无痕标签始终启用

upstream.settings.56f90ffb14.en: Sends Sec-GPC: 1, which some laws make a site honour.
upstream.settings.56f90ffb14.zh-Hans: 发送 Sec-GPC: 1 隐私信号，部分地区的法律要求网站遵循此信号。

upstream.settings.d89270d4ef.en: Only a site you allow reaches your Mac's notifications
upstream.settings.d89270d4ef.zh-Hans: 只有允许的网站才能发送 Mac 系统通知

upstream.settings.060bd36217.en: What each site was allowed or refused
upstream.settings.060bd36217.zh-Hans: 查看各网站曾获准或被拒绝的权限

upstream.settings.c0bc0a021f.en: Its page opens in a panel over the one you're reading
upstream.settings.c0bc0a021f.zh-Hans: 链接页面在当前网页上方的预览面板中打开

upstream.settings.2040b9321b.en: Escape puts it away; the other button keeps it as a tab.
upstream.settings.2040b9321b.zh-Hans: 按 Esc 关闭预览，或用另一个按钮将其保留为标签。

upstream.settings.7b3795dbda.en: Click the wheel, then move the mouse to scroll, as on Windows
upstream.settings.7b3795dbda.zh-Hans: 按下滚轮后移动鼠标即可自动滚动

upstream.settings.e7995407b7.en: Keep your fingers down after a swipe back to pick a page
upstream.settings.e7995407b7.zh-Hans: 向后轻扫后保持手指不离开触控板，以选择历史页面

upstream.settings.62cd3a2895.en: Swipe back or forward and keep your fingers down: the pages that way appear, and moving up or down picks one.
upstream.settings.62cd3a2895.zh-Hans: 向后或向前轻扫后保持手指接触触控板，历史页面会出现，上下移动即可选择。

upstream.settings.048a1b94df.en: Off, SearcheXtra tells you and waits for Install
upstream.settings.048a1b94df.zh-Hans: 关闭后会提示新版本，等待点击“安装”

upstream.settings.8741878c81.en: A local socket for testing; its tabs never take over
upstream.settings.8741878c81.zh-Hans: 使用本地套接字测试，测试标签不会接管你的页面

upstream.settings.3ff52f1b46.en: Its tabs open beside yours with a flask on them. See ./bench.
upstream.settings.3ff52f1b46.zh-Hans: 测试标签会带烧瓶图标并在旁边打开，详见 ./bench。

upstream.settings.87a65dc611.en: Now in Edit › Spelling and Grammar, as in Safari
upstream.settings.87a65dc611.zh-Hans: 可在“编辑 → 拼写与语法”中设置，类似 Safari

upstream.settings.a1c6e4d0fe.en: drag a tab onto a page, or press ⌥⌘N
upstream.settings.a1c6e4d0fe.zh-Hans: 将标签拖到网页上，或按 ⌥⌘N

upstream.settings.b8c8482afc.en: right-click a tab › Add to New Group
upstream.settings.b8c8482afc.zh-Hans: 右键标签 → 添加到新分组

upstream.settings.17d093af2c.en: View › Side Panel, or right-click a tab
upstream.settings.17d093af2c.zh-Hans: 通过“显示 → 侧栏”或右键标签打开

upstream.settings.c9cdbf0253.zh-Hans: 在此 Mac 上翻译网页

upstream.settings.8186f2eb6f.en: Always there: right-click a page › Translate Page
upstream.settings.8186f2eb6f.zh-Hans: 右键网页 → 翻译网页

upstream.settings.f002432498.en: Keep This Site Awake, on the site's card
upstream.settings.f002432498.zh-Hans: 在网站信息中设置“保持此网站唤醒”

upstream.settings.34e7f7c678.en: type red, then Tab, and search Reddit
upstream.settings.34e7f7c678.zh-Hans: 输入 red 后按 Tab，即可搜索 Reddit

upstream.settings.28649bc045.en: right-click a pin › Keep in Every Space
upstream.settings.28649bc045.zh-Hans: 右键固定标签 → 在所有空间保留

upstream.settings.14f2c0903c.en: A pin's number again goes back
upstream.settings.14f2c0903c.zh-Hans: 再次按固定标签编号返回

upstream.settings.1ef84b765c.en: press a pin's ⌘ number again to go back
upstream.settings.1ef84b765c.zh-Hans: 再次按该固定标签的 ⌘ 编号可返回之前的页面

upstream.settings.b657a0710b.zh-Hans: 显示 ⌃Tab 切换器时可使用 ⌃W、⌃R、⌃M 和 ⌃O

upstream.settings.177388989b.en: a link's address at the bottom of the page
upstream.settings.177388989b.zh-Hans: 在网页底部显示链接目标地址

upstream.settings.db3c83a8ff.en: two fingers send it to the corner they point at
upstream.settings.db3c83a8ff.zh-Hans: 用两指将视频推向对应的屏幕角落

upstream.settings.18b9a07d81.en: Only while SearcheXtra isn't set to Light
upstream.settings.18b9a07d81.zh-Hans: 仅在 SearcheXtra 未设为浅色时可用

upstream.settings.e89364ed5e.en: Only with the tabs across the top
upstream.settings.e89364ed5e.zh-Hans: 仅在标签栏位于顶部时可用

upstream.settings.f2d1566f46.en: Only with the tabs down a side
upstream.settings.f2d1566f46.zh-Hans: 仅在标签栏位于侧边时可用

upstream.settings.b4a29191e8.en: Every tab keeps its page, however long you leave it.
upstream.settings.b4a29191e8.zh-Hans: 所有标签始终保留网页，不会因闲置而休眠。

upstream.merge.2a729670ed.en: Apple Passwords didn't hand that password over

upstream.merge.07ee7d714a.en: A page in this group has unsaved form entries. The group will reopen in “{0}” with that Space’s sign-ins, so the entries may be lost.
upstream.merge.07ee7d714a.zh-Hans: 此分组中的页面存在未保存的表单内容。分组将在“{0}”中使用该空间的登录状态重新打开，未保存的输入可能丢失。

upstream.merge.ea24a5e724.en: This page keeps its video to itself
upstream.merge.ea24a5e724.zh-Hans: 此网页不允许悬浮播放视频

upstream.merge.c989f1ce3e.en: Settings, including passwords and updates. ⌘F there finds any setting.
upstream.merge.c989f1ce3e.zh-Hans: 在设置中管理密码和更新，按 ⌘F 可搜索设置。

upstream.merge.9eaab3f001.en: Spaces: separate tabs and sign-ins. Turn them on in Settings › Spaces & Pins, or Set Up Like Arc there.
upstream.merge.9eaab3f001.zh-Hans: 空间提供独立的标签集合和登录状态。可在“设置 → 空间与固定标签”中开启，或选择“设为 Arc 风格”。

upstream.merge.9be6679138.en: Split a page in two, or drag a tab onto a page; ⌃⌘← and ⌃⌘→ go from one page to the other.
upstream.merge.9be6679138.zh-Hans: 将标签拖到网页上可拆分显示，按 ⌃⌘← 或 ⌃⌘→ 切换页面。

upstream.merge.61cf7aea5e.en: Suggestions from your search engine as you type — off until you turn them on in Settings › Browsing.
upstream.merge.61cf7aea5e.zh-Hans: 搜索引擎输入建议默认关闭，可在“设置 → 浏览”中开启。

upstream.merge.63ccb19a4d.en: Held, it can show each tab's number for ⌘1–9. Settings › Tabs.
upstream.merge.63ccb19a4d.zh-Hans: 按住 ⌘ 可显示对应 ⌘1–9 的标签编号，可在“设置 → 标签页”中开启。

upstream.merge.4e8531b6dc.en: Pressed again on its pin, back to where you were.
upstream.merge.4e8531b6dc.zh-Hans: 在固定标签中再次按对应编号，可返回之前的页面。

upstream.merge.a8fa7866a7.en: Float a video in SearcheXtra's window, or in macOS's picture in picture. Settings › Browsing.
upstream.merge.a8fa7866a7.zh-Hans: 在 SearcheXtra 悬浮窗口或 macOS 画中画中播放视频，可在“设置 → 浏览”中选择。

upstream.merge.42a70c0815.en: A website in a side panel beside the page: right-click a tab › Open in Side Panel, or View › Side Panel.
upstream.merge.42a70c0815.zh-Hans: 右键标签选择“在侧栏打开”，或通过“显示 → 侧栏面板”在网页旁打开网站。

upstream.merge.477b4fccbf.en: SearcheXtra can ask before it quits. Settings › General.
upstream.merge.477b4fccbf.zh-Hans: 可在“设置 → 通用”中开启退出前确认。

upstream.merge.c753e8c4c9.en: Passwords from Apple's Passwords app under the sign-in box — off until you turn it on in Settings › Passwords.
upstream.merge.c753e8c4c9.zh-Hans: 在登录框下显示 Apple“密码”账号，默认关闭，可在“设置 → 密码”中开启。

upstream.merge.2a06610b98.en: Translate a page into your language, on this Mac — nothing is sent anywhere. Right-click the page › Translate Page.
upstream.merge.2a06610b98.zh-Hans: 右键网页选择“翻译网页”，即可在此 Mac 上翻译，不会将网页发送到其他服务。

upstream.settings.startPage.short.en: Fresh windows open here; new tabs stay blank unless an extension replaces them.
upstream.settings.startPage.short.zh-Hans: 新窗口打开此页面；新标签默认空白，或使用已选择的新标签扩展。

upstream.appleOffer.help.en: Turns on Apple Passwords and pairs with a code from your Mac. Settings › Passwords turns it off.
upstream.appleOffer.help.zh-Hans: 启用 Apple 密码，并使用 Mac 上的配对码连接。可在“设置 → 密码”中关闭。

upstream.88017ad.7e5d69be4d.en: Across the top of the window, down a side as a column, or as icons only
upstream.88017ad.7e5d69be4d.zh-Hans: 可在窗口顶部、两侧显示标签页，也可仅显示图标

upstream.88017ad.3aa9715b2e.en: Icons only is a narrow column of each tab's icon, the title in a tooltip. Nothing grows under the pointer.
upstream.88017ad.3aa9715b2e.zh-Hans: 仅显示图标时，标签页排列为窄图标栏，鼠标悬停可查看标题，图标不会随悬停放大。

upstream.88017ad.fab3c3b5c5.en: Closing a tab goes back to the one before
upstream.88017ad.fab3c3b5c5.zh-Hans: 关闭标签页后返回上次查看的标签页

upstream.88017ad.5198315823.en: Otherwise you land on the tab beside it
upstream.88017ad.5198315823.zh-Hans: 关闭后默认选择相邻标签页

upstream.88017ad.8541bf11cc.en: The tab you viewed last in this space, as ⌃Tab would take you. The other half of a Split View stays first.
upstream.88017ad.8541bf11cc.zh-Hans: 返回此空间中上次查看的标签页，与 ⌃Tab 一致。分屏中的另一页面仍优先。

upstream.88017ad.f654ec5618.en: ⇧⌘R shows a page's article alone, in clean type. Most docs sites publish a Markdown copy; nothing in it can run, its text is escaped.
upstream.88017ad.f654ec5618.zh-Hans: ⇧⌘R 以简洁排版显示网页正文。多数文档网站提供 Markdown 副本；内容经过转义，不会执行其中的代码。

upstream.88017ad.133181a7e0.en: Third parties whose only job is to watch, and YouTube's ads
upstream.88017ad.133181a7e0.zh-Hans: 拦截第三方跟踪器和 YouTube 广告

upstream.88017ad.79b365167e.en: On YouTube, the ads announced in the player's own data are taken out before the video starts. Turn it off for one site from the site's row.
upstream.88017ad.79b365167e.zh-Hans: 在 YouTube 视频开始前移除播放器数据中的广告。可在网站设置中单独关闭拦截。

upstream.88017ad.61579a8b34.en: Only with titles in the column
upstream.88017ad.61579a8b34.zh-Hans: 仅适用于带标题的侧栏

upstream.88017ad.d29d8693eb.en: Click, then press the new shortcut
upstream.88017ad.d29d8693eb.zh-Hans: 点击后按下新的快捷键

upstream.address.floatingNewTab.en: New tab in a floating field
upstream.address.floatingNewTab.zh-Hans: 在浮动输入框中新建标签页

upstream.address.floatingNewTab.detail.en: Ask for an address first; a tab opens when you press Return
upstream.address.floatingNewTab.detail.zh-Hans: 先输入网址，按回车后再创建标签页
